notes: Mid-market SaaS (customer support platform) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as primary path and Dedicated for production commit.
Primary workload: multi-turn chat agent for customer support + outbound actioning via tool calling (CRM updates, ticket triage).

Latency focus: targeting 1st-token <= 200ms for short queries (<= 128 tokens), streaming required for agent UX. Currently measuring 200-500ms on competitors; wants to confirm Redwood streaming/TTFT numbers in hosted plan.
Throughput: expected steady-state ~30-60 qps during peak; burst capacity for product-led growth spikes. Prefers predictable tail latencies vs absolute lowest cost.
Security: must pass SOC2 + SSO/SAML + audit logging. Explicit ask: PII redaction in logs and ability to configure retention (30/90/365 days). Need KMS support for key management.

POC plan: 2-week hosted API POC (integration + latency benchmarking) -> 4-week extended POC on Dedicated if hosted meets functional + security checkpoints. Team wants the Hosted POC to include tool-calling demo (ticket close action) and streaming behavior under load.

Pricing: mid-market budget sensitivity. Interested in usage-based for POC then review Dedicated reserved capacity pricing. AE to provide pricing deck and sample ARR bands. Estimated ARR if Dedicated: $30k-$80k annual depending on committed qps and retention add-ons.
Quotes from demo: 'We need the agent to feel instant — streaming is table stakes.'; 'If Redwood can show consistent first byte under 200ms we can justify Dedicated.'

Security review notes: security team requested SOC2 report + pen-test summary, SSO/SAML metadata flow, detailed logging schema (what is redacted), and data residency options. Also asked for contractual language around data deletion for end-user PII.
Technical preferences: prefer open models with quantization options; fallback routing desired (hosted -> dedicated plan -> smaller model) for graceful degradation during incidents.
Risk: concerned about token costs with long context threads. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (caching, prefix KV) to reduce token spend.

Action items assigned: AE (Alex) — send pricing deck + Redwood SOC2 copy; SE (Ravi) — run streaming latency benchmark on small test corpus; Security (Maya — CSM) coordinate data retention policy template with customer security team.
Blockers reiterated: need SOC2 docs and PII redaction proof before procurement commit; also want SLA numbers for hosted plan or commitment timeline to Dedicated capacity.
Notes on integrations: will demo tool-calls to Zendesk + internal ticketing via Redwood function calls. Need examples of audit log entries showing redacted payloads.
